name: Onnasamurai Natsume ~Akuochi Kyonyuu Onnasamurai o Sukuidase~
original_name: 女侍ナツメ ～悪堕ち巨乳女侍を救い出せ～
source:
The story of Aoi, a female samurai brainwashed by villains and corrupted into evil, and Natsume, a female samurai subjected to the depraved whims of an erotic magistrate through hypnosis!

The female samurai Natsume and Aoi, both renowned as skilled officials, are expert swordswomen. The two receive word of lawless criminals appearing in their domain and rush to the village where the disturbance is taking place.

However, a trap awaits them, set by the villains targeting the two. The female samurai Aoi is captured by the enemy...
